title: Senior Manager, Regional Key Account Management
description:
This position will be accountable for managing, directing and leading the CEVA Logistics programs for BYD across the LATAM region.

Key Accountabilities

1

Ability to understand unique customer supply chain requirements and drive a particular sector focus

2

Identify business opportunities that add value to BYD logistics programs whilst generating business leads that meet and exceed business goals

3

Expansion/Growth is mission critical to the role. Senior relationship management and service execution are two key components to insure account expansion/growth is achieved

4

Retention is key to grow portfolio of business across all product/service types within CEVA

5

Drive collaborative efforts between country and multiple product leaders within CEVA to meet the needs of customers

6

Prospecting for all products opportunities and delivering compelling solutions, value and pricing

7

Maintain an Account Plan for the customer that will encompass a strategic roadmap defining multi-year growth, targets by key supply chain

8

Execute Account Plans (forecasts, budgets and operating plans)

9

Ability to work in a matrix organization along with virtual teams & build strong internal relationships with Sponsor/Global/Regional/Sector team leaders as required for the account

10

Build strategic relationships with key contacts within customer organizations to understand opportunities for creating value

11

Stay aligned and team work with GKAM and other region RKAMs

12

Conduct regular business review meetings with customers and drive meeting content to ensure operations, support and execution teams are present to support these reviews

13

Responsible to communicate all expectations on these review meetings to the operations and support teams for implementation or improvements

14

Lead & create innovation solution with team based on deep understanding of business streams of customer

15

Leverage on Sectors Focused Solutions to penetrate account growth and development (Eg. Use of case studies and key SMART solutions within CEVA)

16

Work with implementation teams on new projects to ensure customer expectations are communicated

17

Lead and work with customer to resolve all contractual and commercial decisions in compliance with CEVA policies and terms

18

Continue cross selling within CEVA and CMA CGM group to maximize biz portfolio for the group

19

Accurate and timely update of all customer engagement activities and business development opportunities within C-View

20

Need to support other China-Brazil sales leads and Chinese projects/business

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years industry experience.
  • Minimum 8 years account management managerial and/or customer relationship management experience required.
  • Bachelor degree holder majoring in supply chain/logistics/ /transportation management/sales and marketing/international business
  • In-depth knowledge of all air,sea, ground and contract logistics products and services.
  • Excellent planning, time management, collaboration, decision making, organization, presentation and negotiating skills.
  • Strong background in sales and marketing and a proven track recordin business development and growth.
  • Demonstrated success in managing (KPI's) Key Performance Indicators.
  • Demonstrated success in problem solving through use of data and information metrics and improvement to performance process.
  • Proficient in project management methodologies with a focus on managing solution driven strategy plans to achieve goals.
  • Experienced in financial management (P&L's, Balance Sheets,forecasting and budgets) to effectuate return on investment.
  • Manages complex or emotional customer situations promptly andprofessionally meeting commitments for service and assistance.
  • Maintains stable performance underpressure or opposition; handling stress in a mannerthat is acceptable to others and the organization.
  • Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive teamand facilitates the completion of team goals.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Fluent in both Chinese and English
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);

title: Supervisor de Manutenção Mecânica - Planta de Beneficiamento
description:
Supervisor de Manutenção Mecânica – Planta de Beneficiamento

Local: Interior da Bahia, Brasil

Modelo de trabalho: Disponibilidade de mudança para a região (empresa oferece moradia)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor de Manutenção Mecânica que será responsável por planejar, coordenar e acompanhar as atividades de manutenção mecânica em equipamentos industriais da usina, garantindo sua disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança operacional, de acordo com os padrões de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar e distribuir as atividades de manutenção mecânica preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em equipamentos da planta (britadores, moinhos, correias, tanques, bombas etc.);
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos planos de manutenção e paradas programadas, garantindo a execução dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Acompanhar a execução de serviços internos e de terceiros, garantindo qualidade e conformidade com normas técnicas e de segurança;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos de melhoria contínua, visando aumento da confiabilidade, redução de falhas e otimização de recursos;
  • Coordenar e orientar tecnicamente a equipe de manutenção, promovendo capacitação, integração e cultura de segurança;
  • Realizar e validar registros no sistema de gestão de manutenção, contribuindo para o controle de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Apoiar o planejamento orçamentário e o controle de custos da manutenção mecânica;
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Compliance, assegurando a integridade das pessoas e dos equipamentos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica e/ou Eletromecânica;
  • Experiência em manutenção mecânica em equipamentos de usina de beneficiamento mineral (britadores, correias, bombas, peneiras, etc);
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes operacionais e contratos terceirizados;
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para o interior da Bahia.

title: Customs Specialist
description:

  • Responsible for accurately reviewing customs codes,proficiently applying trade preferential policies and relevant tax rules, conducting tariff analysis and commodity classification audits on imported and exported goods, and adopting legal and compliant tariff preferential tax rules;
  • Coordinate the system requirements docking of the customs information module,implement the construction and functional improvement of the customs clearance
  • system;
  • Served as a consultant for customs system, responsible for daily business system operation cooperation, online and daily exception handling, processing trade compliance self
  • inspection,management,etc:

  • handling abnormal issues.

  • College degree or above,
  • Able to work overseas for 3 year or more,
  • Strong proficiency in English/Chinese for Portuguese Native Speakers (listening,speaking, reading, and writing).Or strong proficiency in Portuguese for Chinese Native Speakers:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement.
  • Deep expertise in AWS, especially working with services like ECS, IAM, and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, ideally using frameworks like Backstage.
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic, such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced).

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform, enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS, based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows, including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Software engineer sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações webutilizandoJava Script/Type Scripte frameworks modernos comoReact e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office(trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros:Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais(Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba(pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais(com oportunidade de promoção)Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefacté o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso:cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura:junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo:você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!
Junte-se a nós!

title: Sap advanced business application programming consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazilwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4 HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4 HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4 HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4 HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.
Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAd I, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4 HANA Private Cloud, S/4 HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.
Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement
Setup and configure necessary S/4 HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.
Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.
Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features
Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.
Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.
Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues
Provide sufficient documentations on features developed
Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation
Follow agile development principles and best practice during development
Participate in daily scrums
Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates
Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from Service Now. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in Servicew Now incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.
Maintain communication and documentation in English
Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline
What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#Buildingonbelief

title: Sales manager -  nutraceutical ingredients ( latam)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)Location: Brazil (Remote)Territory: Latin AmericaAbout the RoleWe’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.Responsibilities
• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.
• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.
• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.
• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.
• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.
• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).Requirements
• 5+ years of B2 B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.
• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.
• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.
• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.
• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.
• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.
• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaboratewith data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
OptimizeETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintainand improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshootand resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados  - vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.
O que estamos procurando:Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações
O que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

title: Data engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forData Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;
- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;
- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and Dynamo DB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;
- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;
- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;
- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;
- English
Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;
- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment
Key responsibilities:
Design and implement an AWS Serverless Data Lake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;
- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the Data Lake;
- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;
- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the Data Lake;
- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or Dynamo DB, to provide high-performance access to the data;
- Monitor and troubleshoot the Data Lake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;
- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the Data Lake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;
- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines
Data lake, aws, spark, python

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)

Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality

Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools
Portuguese + English fluencyNon-Negotiables:
Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)

Obsessive attention to detail

Knowledge of serverless architecture and Lambda functions
Java or Cloud certifications

title: Graphic designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yeah, you heard that right.Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!Key Responsibilities
Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.Qualifications
Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft programs (Power Point and Word)
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as Chat GPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
A working level of written and spoken EnglishOur operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior devops engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.We are currently hiring aSenior Dev Ops Engineer with AWS CDK knowledgefor an initial 12-month B2 B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and Type Script and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.Responsibilities:
Participate in our Dev Ops team
Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leadsRequirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in Dev Ops roles
Hands-on experience with Type Script and AWS CDK
Coding experience in implementing business features
Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Cloud Front, Event Bridge, App Sync, Dynamo Db, Open Search
Business-level proficiency in EnglishThe successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
Take ownership and be accountable for their work
Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
Adopt a proactive, hands-on approachWhat can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Cloud platform developer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.Responsibilities and Duties
Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5 G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.Essential Skills
Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
How to work on the command line and with files;
How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
How to create and run simple scripts;
Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Docker;
Experience with Helm.Highly Desirable Skills
Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Postgre SQL as a developer;
Experience with Rabbit MQ as a developer.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(go e java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel
Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.
Visão geral do cargo
E stamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou plenopara projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.
• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).
• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.
• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Executive search consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:
Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.About the Role
We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.WHAT YOU WILL DOCandidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)
Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
Passive search: Source, screen applicants
Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessmentEnd to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)
Build and manage candidate pipeline
Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
Support client communications and progress check-ins.
Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.Business Development Support (10%)
Research companies, markets, and potential clients
Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the companyIDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled \"Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

title: Data engineer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.
Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Companyportfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your Team
At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.
Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.The Impact You'll Make
In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.What You’ll Do
Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.About You
2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
Fluency in English is required
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
Hands-on experience withdata laketechnologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
Familiarity with Dev Ops practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, New Relic, Pager Duty)
Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaborationNice to have:
Experience with Infrastructure asCode (Terraform )
Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines usingAirflowandSparkThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Senior product experience designer (remote) - b2b healthtech saas
description:
Ongoing contract role ·10 hours per week· Remote (Brazil Based)
Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
International team across Brazil and North America
5+ years of designing Saa S web applications(required)
Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
Fluent English required - written and spokenAbout the Role
We’re looking for aSenior Product Experience Designerto help shape the user experience of a Saa S web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.This role is intentionally scoped at10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused onsenior-level product experience design- the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.This role is well suited to someone who:
enjoys focused, high-impact work,
may already have other professional commitments,
and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to designend-to-end product experiences— from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.About Optive
We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.Our team works across two closely related platforms:
Optive- a patient engagement and care platform
Optimal DX- an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners todayYou’ll contribute experience design work acrossboth platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.What You'll Do
Designend-to-end user journeysfor complex Saa S web applications
Translate product goals intoclear workflows, flows, and wireframes
Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
Communicate clearly with an international team inEnglish , both written and spokenWhy this Role Might be a Fit
Have5+ years of experiencedesigning customer-facing Saa S products or complex web applications
Have worked on products that real customers use in production
Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
Can overlap some working hours with PST
Communicate fluently in EnglishPreferred Background
While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:
Designedcomplex Saa S or web applicationsused in production
Owned or heavily influencedend-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2 B, or data-heavy products)
Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impactIf your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.Proof Matters
We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:
Screenshots of shipped Saa S products
Annotated flows or wireframes
Case studies explaining experience design decisions
Clear examples of problems you personally solvedWe understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who canpoint to real experience design workand talk concretely about the decisions behind it.How to Apply
Apply via Linked In.Please include:
A short note about your experience designing Saa S or web applications
Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(go e java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel
Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.
Visão geral do cargo
E stamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou plenopara projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.
• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).
• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.
• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.
