title: Business developer for social media
description:

Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken

Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainmentIf you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!

title: Desenvolvimento kotlin, java, python aws - 123816
description:
Sobre a vagaCom mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.
Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.
Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.O que estamos buscando?Desenvolvimento Salesforce SêniorRequisitos:
Kotlin, com ênfase em Java Spring Boot, Python e AWS. Requisitos Técnicos: Kotlin (Habilidade Principal). Experiência com Kotlin para desenvolvimento backend. Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, Mock K ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e Graph QL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **Fast API ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e Num Py** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, Dynamo DB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou Cloud Formation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **Cloud Watch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Argo CD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (Postgre SQL, My SQL) e No SQL (Mongo DB, Dynamo DB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou Rabbit MQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e Graph QL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando Postgre SQL, Dynamo DB ou Mongo DB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, Dynamo DB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS Cloud Watch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. Dev Ops e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.Requisitos e Qualificações:
Experiência com Omni Studio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;Descrição comportamental:
Procuramos uma pessoa que:
Goste de trabalhar em equipe e sejacolaborativaem suas atribuições;
Tenhacoragempara se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
Transforme ideias emsoluções criativase busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
Tenha habilidades deresolução de problemas ;
Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente egerenciar o próprio tempo ;
Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas einovadorasno âmbito tecnológico.O que oferecemos:Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

title: Programador ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa:Oni Learning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, Oni Learning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de Oni Learning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!Descrição do Cargo:Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.Qualificações:
Desenvolvimento em Ruby:Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia

title: Customer success specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.About us:
Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U. S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.What You’ll Own:
Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later,Monday to FridayWhat We’re Looking For:
4+ years in a quota-carrying Customer Success, Account Management or growth-focused positions in a Saa S company
Proficient or native level English (full business fluency), both written and verbal
Confident, direct communicator with a partnership mindset
Highly analytical; comfortable interpreting data and trends
Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized
Engaging, personable, and energetic in customer interactions
Sales-trained and able to identify business expansion opportunities
Proven track record of meeting and/or exceeding a business expansion quota✨ Bonus Points:
Experience working at a telecom Saa S
Strong real estate investor (REI) industry knowledge
Deep understanding of SMS performance, compliance, and deliverability⚡️ Why Smarter Contact?
USD base + variable compensation
15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
Professional development benefit
Wellness benefit
Employment anniversary and birthday gift
Quarterly health allowance
Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don’t Apply If:
You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
You’re not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
You don’t meet the minimum customer success experience
No experience working for a Saa S companyReady to grow with us?
We’re looking for a proven Customer Success Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that’s you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate DevelopmentPerseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.Location:BrazilThe Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Phd peer reviewer needed: professor of civil and structural engineering
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.WHAT YOU NEED to Have
Doctorate Ph D or equivalent advanced degreein the subject area
Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systemsWHAT YOU WILL DO
Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Human resources specialist
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.OurHR Managerwill take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.Joining our team you will be focusing on
Working as an integral part of the Turn Key HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.

title: Swe manager - mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?
A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.
Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.
Nossa cultura:
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
⚡ Own It:Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride:Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit:Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play:Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason:O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.Como é ser uma pessoa Engineering Manager:
Ser Engineering Manager na Stone significa liderar equipes de engenharia de software, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados. É esperado que você atue como facilitador, garantindo que os times tenham clareza de propósito e os recursos necessários para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. Além disso, você será responsável por alinhar as metas técnicas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, promovendo o crescimento profissional dos membros da equipe e fomentando uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo. Além de:Liderar e desenvolver times de engenharia, com foco em alta performance e crescimento individual.
Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa, propagando e conectando direcionamento técnico alinhado a estrategia;
Garantir a entrega de soluções técnicas alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio, em parceria com PMs, Designers e outras lideranças.
Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento.
Promover um ambiente de colaboração, segurança psicológica e feedback constante.
Garantir construção de estratégias técnicas dos domínios do time, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia (Clean Code, TDD, CI/CD, Dev Sec Ops).
Participar da definição e acompanhamento de OKRs e métricas técnicas (lead time, estabilidade, cobertura de testes etc.).
Incentivar iniciativas de Inner Source, uso de RFCs e cultura de documentação viva.
Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;
Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto/plataforma;
Definir, coletar, analisar e acompanhar métricas de saúde de aplicações/produtos;O que esperamos de você:
Experiência em liderança de times técnicos multidisciplinares baseado em princípios e adoção de metodologias ágeis (scrum / kanban);
Ser um embaixador no time da nossa cultura de alta colaboração e qualidade;
Experiência em ambiente com arquitetura robusta e escalável;
Fortes conhecimentos e experiência em liderança de times adotando padrões arquiteturais e design de código, padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
Experiência em desenvolvimento Mobile android/i OS;
Sólidos conhecimentos em API RESTful / Protocolo HTTP;
Sólidos conhecimentos sobre algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
Sólidos conhecimentos dos princípios SOLID, Clean Code e Design Patterns;
Experiência em investigações, troubleshooting, telemetria, monitoramento, observabilidade e depuração de sistemas em geral;
Experiência com Teste de Software: Unitário, integração, estresse, mutação e E2 E;
Conhecimentos em bancos de dados e modelagens relacionais e não relacionais, estratégias de cache e processamento distribuído;
Conhecimentos sobre Dev Ops: CI/CD, automatizações e a cultura em si;
Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
Experiência em gestão de plataforma mobile (cliente dev interno).O que aumenta as suas chances:
Experiência em gestão de times de experiência / jornada;
Experiência em gestão de times com responsabilidade em desenvolvimento de Design System;
Experiência com desenvolvimento KMP (Kotlin Multiplatform) e CMP(Compose Multiplatform);
Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações com React Native;
Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações backend com linguagens Golang, Node e C# ou outra linguagem moderna de backend (adicional);
Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e/ou apps de larga escala;
Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade.Nossos benefícios:
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Gympass
Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses

Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Confira aqui as diretrizes do nosso Código de Ética.

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled \"Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Java com experiência comprovada em liderança de times técnicos. Procuramos alguém com sólida bagagem em desenvolvimento backend, que conheça os desafios de ambientes de alta performance e que tenha atuado como referência técnica e gestora de equipe.

Experiência com Hibernate, JUnit 5, Mockito 2 e Git.

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.

Experiência em ambientes de alta concorrência, performance e grandes volumes de dados.

title: Senior product experience designer (remote) - b2b healthtech saas
description:
Ongoing contract role ·10 hours per week· Remote (Brazil Based)
Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
International team across Brazil and North America
5+ years of designing Saa S web applications(required)
Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
Fluent English required - written and spokenAbout the Role
We’re looking for aSenior Product Experience Designerto help shape the user experience of a Saa S web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.This role is intentionally scoped at10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused onsenior-level product experience design- the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.This role is well suited to someone who:
enjoys focused, high-impact work,
may already have other professional commitments,
and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to designend-to-end product experiences— from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.About Optive
We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.Our team works across two closely related platforms:
Optive- a patient engagement and care platform
Optimal DX- an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners todayYou’ll contribute experience design work acrossboth platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.What You'll Do
Designend-to-end user journeysfor complex Saa S web applications
Translate product goals intoclear workflows, flows, and wireframes
Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
Communicate clearly with an international team inEnglish , both written and spokenWhy this Role Might be a Fit
Have5+ years of experiencedesigning customer-facing Saa S products or complex web applications
Have worked on products that real customers use in production
Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
Can overlap some working hours with PST
Communicate fluently in EnglishPreferred Background
While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:
Designedcomplex Saa S or web applicationsused in production
Owned or heavily influencedend-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2 B, or data-heavy products)
Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impactIf your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.Proof Matters
We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:
Screenshots of shipped Saa S products
Annotated flows or wireframes
Case studies explaining experience design decisions
Clear examples of problems you personally solvedWe understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who canpoint to real experience design workand talk concretely about the decisions behind it.How to Apply
Apply via Linked In.Please include:
A short note about your experience designing Saa S or web applications
Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

title: Ugc coordinator
description:

title: Product implementer / dtp freelancer
description:
Do you have a creative mindset backed by technical skills, experience in DTP, or a strong desire to learn?
Bubbly Doo is looking for a hands-on freelance Product Implementer to join our team on a flexible basis, starting in Q1 2026. You will kick off with Valentine’s, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day books for our in-house products, but also for various licensing partners (such as Peppa Pig from Hasbro, PAW Patrol from Paramount, Barbie from Mattel, and more!). You’ll support the launch of new personalized children’s books and products, working closely with our in-house team and software developer.

Use various in-house tools like our Translation Tool and Product Builder to fully implement our books and the translations of our books and products
Prepare and configure our CMS for each new launch
Have direct contact with our translators, illustrators and editors for quality review and product improvements
Support with organizing Photoshop files to ensure all visual assets are ready for production
What we’re looking for
Flexible availability starting in January 2026, with an initial onboarding and training phase, followed by a predominantly full-time availability through at least June. Workload may vary at times, and timing and continuation will be evaluated together afterwards.
Strong communication skills
Comfortable using internal tools and learning quickly
Proactive, detail-oriented, and structured
What’s in it for you
Join a small, young, and passionate team that cares deeply about what we create
Take ownership and responsibility for the quality of our product line
Compensation to be agreed upon
For questions or more information about the role, don’t hesitate to reach out to
Looking forward to connect and to a great collaboration!

title: Electrical bim lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence inBrazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA. of working with us:
Competitive Salary
Annual Bonus
Learning platforms that enable growth and development
Strong leadership and mentorshipRoles and Responsibilities
Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.Qualifications
2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.Preferrable
Solid understanding of U. S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
Prior experience working on Data Centers.
